_about: The Change Desk's settings, as first loaded into changedesk.settings by scripts/setup_db.py. KB-139 section 7 holds the starting values and KB-136 section 6 the reasons. After the first load the table is the one home: a change is made with changedesk.set_setting (who, when, why), never here. Rows marked 'build addition' are not in KB-139 section 7; the build needed them and each says why.

settings.description: Urgent buffer: 10% of the week (4 hours). It takes more if it must, and that is logged
Small and quick share: 20% of the week (8 hours), oldest first
Standard share: about 70% of the week (28 hours), by score plus age
Size limit for the small lane: two hours or less
Points for each week waited, on a ten-point scale
Age limit, small lane: past it the item goes on the decide list
Age limit, standard lane: past it the item goes on the decide list
Latest safe start: the due date, less the time such work has needed 85% of the time
Lane growth flag: more in than out, this many weeks running
Update trigger: an update is drafted only when the 85% date moves by more than this many days
Score parts and weights: value 30%, effort 20%, risk 20%, goal fit 20%, readiness 10% (the Decision Engine's form; KB-139 section 10, choice 4)
An item larger than this (a day of work) comes with a proposed split into pieces of this size or less (R8)
settings.source: build addition: R8 says 'pieces of a day or less'; a day is the 8 hours of a 40-hour week

settings.description: Forecast: how many runs of the weeks ahead, each with its own new arrivals drawn from each lane's own history
settings.source: build addition: R18 needs 'many runs' (KB-139 section 6.1); 1000 keeps the 85% and 95% dates steady to a day or two

settings.description: Forecast: how many weeks ahead each run looks. An item not done by then in enough runs gets no date at that level
settings.source: build addition: half a year, as the policy test in KB-136 section 6.6

settings.description: Forecast: the fixed seed of the random draws, so the same store and settings give the same forecast and the tests repeat
settings.source: build addition: stage 4 asks for a fixed seed; 163 is the initiative's number

settings.description: Effort points from the size in hours: less work scores higher. The first band whose limit the size is within
settings.source: build addition: R9 needs the effort part to show its reason; a published rule from the size is that reason
